stage: L2 and same fixed protocol forL3

scope.pressure: L1 diagnostic only; not main decision
scope.low_CoC: B2-low descriptive control, not scored as pass/fail

renderer: native deterministic fixed64, no analytic inflation
selection: L0 zero-aperture focus criterion passes VG-AA; VP remains a finite-aperture coverage-failure diagnosis. L1 analytic modes fail quality/temporalNI, so fixed64 isolates structure

band.definition: 3x3 relative inverse-depth jump, union of max-local-CoC1.5x footprints; exclusively target current visible depth
band.primary_evaluation: band excluding previously flagged peeled-reference residual pixels;band itself is never GT-filtered
band.report: independent disocclusionGT recall/precision/FP/FN, unknownGT support and CoC distribution; no tuning toGT recall

quality.direction: PSNRgain>0 AND LPIPSchange<-3noise;absLPIPSchange<=3noise is tie,not direction improvement or significant deterioration
quality.guardrails: per-focus pooled full-image and in-focus PSNR versusO3 each drop<=0.2dB; individual cases also reported

noise.source: L1 preregistered band-weighted independent Cycles pairs at frames1/30;maximum corresponding lens pair used forframe60

statistics.PSNR: poolfloat64SSE/(3validpixels), then -10log10; independently per scene/focus, each aperture also reported
statistics.patch_pool: whole unmasked fixed64px grid weighted by regional pixel support
statistics.RGB: standard displayRGBfloat[0,1];raw linearEXR retained;3D integrates true linearRGB
statistics.full_image: all pixels including sky and peeled-reference residuals

comparisons.mechanism: stage method versusO5_shared with identical input-only fill
L2_controls: L2 with selected hidden parents and per-ray output band activation
comparisons.descriptive: O3 outside+fullO6 inside band, reference only; never part of formal decisions
L3: fraction ofL2MSE reduction retained vsO3,only whenL2 improvesMSE

C_fill.mask: union of input-visible depth bands over predetermined main/pressure lenses,5x5 dilation2
C_fill.depth: max current visible finite depth within radius ceil(2maxCoC)+4;sky10km;input-only background extension proxy
C_fill.composition: merge visible+hidden,depth-sort andalpha-compose per lens ray;remainingT*projectedLaMa lookup,average64 in linearRGB
C_fill.delta_to_B2: B2GTseg/truehiddenBG depth not allowed asL3 inputs; include same-new-fill O5 and full-hidden controls to isolate this change

L2.hidden: B2O6-GT-rec truehiddenparents;only parentcenters inband;hiddenalpha disabled outside outputband for each ray
L2.name: 可恢复表面的 GT Oracle

L3.retrieval_cache: unionband cache independent of currentfocal setting;render applies frozen per-lens band
L3.dynamic: diagnose separate current dynamic-pixel error and hidden-dynamic geometrycoverage using GT only in evaluator
L3.geometry_coverage: GT recovered-aperture ray center-projection nearestparent depthwithin max5mm,2%;evaluation only

interpretations: L2/L3 remain controlledscene geometryOracle diagnostics,not trained methods
L2minusO3 is not singlefactor hidden-content attribution
L3 geometrycoverage is not texture correctness
one main controlledscene pluslowCoCcontrol,6groups per focus;no crossscene generalization
optional_L4: only consider if at least onehigh-focusL3 passes;optional,not automatic
